annotations.title: Assess starting workflows for an agency

description: Take short answers about an insurance agency and return 5 to 10 starting workflows from the built-in benefits and P&C library. Asks for line of business, team size, how AI is used today, whether data rules are written, and the main bottleneck.

bottleneck.description: The work that takes the most time, such as renewals, census, certificates, quoting, or loss runs.

data_rules.description: yes or no. Whether the agency has written data rules for AI tools.

health_information.description: yes, no, or unsure. Whether the work includes health information.

team_size.description: Headcount or a band such as 1-10, 11-25, or 26+.

name: assess_ai_readiness
title: Assess starting workflows for an agency
